name: Dynamic NeRF Guided by Projected Colors
definition: A dynamic NeRF variant that replaces the temporal input coordinate $t$ with multi-view projected color statistics to improve point correspondence estimation for on-the-fly training, avoiding the irregular trajectories found in space-time deformation fields.
summary: Dynamic NeRF Guided by Projected Colors replaces temporal coordinates with multi-view color statistics to improve point correspondence and reduce optimization time in dynamic scenes.
